description: This file defines CLI completion commands and functions for various shells (zsh, bash, powershell, fish). It includes functions for resolving shell environment, generating completion scripts, checking and installing completion scripts, and registering CLI commands for completion. It is part of a CLI tool's source code, specifically handling shell completion features.

methods.name: resolveShellFromEnv
methods.description: Determines the shell type (zsh, bash, fish, powershell) from environment variables.

methods.name: completionCacheExists
methods.description: Checks if the completion cache file exists for a given shell and binary name.

methods.name: getCompletionScript
methods.description: Returns the completion script string for a specified shell and program.

methods.name: isCompletionInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the completion script is installed in the user's shell profile.

methods.name: usesSlowDynamicCompletion
methods.description: Determines if the profile uses dynamic (slow) completion pattern.

methods.name: registerCompletionCli
methods.description: Registers the 'completion' command in the CLI program for generating completion scripts.

methods.name: installCompletion
methods.description: Automates the installation of completion scripts into the user's shell profile.
